shortcut: Test environment mismatch hiding browser bugs
detail: Running tests designed for jsdom in node environment (or vice versa) hides environment-specific bugs. Code that depends on window, document, or DOM APIs passes in jsdom tests but fails in production because jsdom provides incomplete polyfills. Conversely, code using node-specific APIs passes tests but cannot run in the browser. This error is especially common in isomorphic TypeScript codebases. Prerequisite: understanding jsdom limitations and node vs browser APIs. Requires correct vitest environment configuration per test file. To mitigate: use @vitest/environment comments to explicitly set the test environment. Fix: verify test environments match deployment targets, test SSR code in node and browser code in jsdom.
